knownIssues.symptom: The game refuses to start with 'Your graphics card does not support Shader Model 6.7'
knownIssues.cause: the Intel engines' D3DMetal reports Shader Model 6.6
knownIssues.fix: this recipe asks for the native arm64 preview engine, which the game runs on through vkd3d-proton (shown to installs with the preview key)

knownIssues.symptom: A short freeze of one to two seconds a few times a flight, more in daylight
knownIssues.cause: Metal stopping on lossless-compressed images the game copies every frame
knownIssues.fix: this recipe sets HB_MVK_NO_LOSSLESS=1 on the environment, which removes most of them; one flight in four still shows two in daylight

knownIssues.symptom: About one start in sixteen ends in a crash during the world load
knownIssues.cause: under study (memory corruption during the load)

knownIssues.symptom: Seven minutes to the start screen and four more from Start to the cockpit
knownIssues.cause: the emulator translating the game's code and the shader preparation
knownIssues.fix: none; the second start reuses the shader and code caches

knownIssues.symptom: Far map tiles stay coarse on the Free Flight page away from the departure airport, and the main menu's globe shows pale wedges over the oceans
Some lights and line effects are missing
Smeared picture when the view turns
knownIssues.cause: the game's motion blur at these frame rates
knownIssues.fix: turn Motion Blur off in the game's graphics settings

lastVerified.engine: arm64-wine11.18-r5 (Wine 11.18 with patches-arm64 0001 to 0043, FEX 2610 with fex/patches 0001 to 0023 and this recipe's FEX switches, MoltenVK 1.4.2 with patches 0001 to 0016, vkd3d-proton)
lastVerified.result: Steam copy (2537590) on a Mac mini M4 with 32 GB through Highball's test harness, in daylight at Gibraltar in a Cessna 172: boot, Free Flight, three 2-minute parks and three 1-minute take-off rolls with two in-game restarts a flight, at the Medium preset with FSR Balanced in 1080p. With this recipe's FEX switches (engine r5, FEX patch 0023), three flights against two on r4: frames over 100 ms 4 per park instead of 59 and 21 per minute of take-off roll instead of 55, frames over 250 ms 0.4 instead of 9 per park, the 99th percentile frame time 70 ms parked instead of 160, 23 fps parked and 19 rolling instead of 19 and 16. No crash, no GPU hang, about 7 minutes to the start screen and 13 to the cockpit. Not tested: camera turns, a longer flight, other aircraft or airports, a controller, any other Mac.

steps.text: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 runs on Highball's native arm64 preview engine only, which this recipe asks for (installs with the preview key see it; the Intel engines cannot start the game). It needs about 25 GB of memory, so a 16 GB Mac is unlikely to hold it. The first start takes about seven minutes to the start screen and four more from Start to the cockpit; later starts reuse the shader and code caches. Expect about 23 fps parked and 19 on the take-off roll in daylight at the Medium preset with FSR Balanced in 1080p on a base M4, and turn Motion Blur off in the graphics settings.
